response.sql: WITH playlist_counts AS (SELECT p.PlaylistId, COUNT(pt.TrackId) as track_count FROM Playlist p LEFT JOIN PlaylistTrack pt ON p.PlaylistId = pt.PlaylistId GROUP BY p.PlaylistId), average_calc AS (SELECT AVG(track_count) as avg_count FROM playlist_counts) SELECT pc.PlaylistId, pc.track_count, pc.track_count / ac.avg_count as ratio FROM playlist_counts pc CROSS JOIN average_calc ac ORDER BY ratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
